- close: Closing price. [Available at the close of each bar. Point in time.]
- ret: Simple return from the previous close to this close. NaN after a delisting. [Available at the close of each bar. Point in time.]
- volume: Shares traded in the bar. [Available at the close of each bar. Point in time.]
- eps_reported: Standardised earnings surprise (reported minus expe
